what: a curve network of four straight lines in two directions, corners (0,0,0), (20,0,0), (20,20,0), (0,20,10): the Coons patch, a hyperbolic paraboloid
method: the Coons patch of four lines is bilinear: P(s,t) = (20s, 20t, 10(1-s)t); |Ps x Pt| = 200 sqrt(4 + t^2 + (1-s)^2); A = 200 * double integral over the unit square = 431.6148 (Gauss-Legendre 48 x 48); one face, 4 free edges
